cohort: 501 women with singleton gestations and no previous preterm birth or history of late miscarriage, who had previously undergone a single LEEP for CIN 2-3
finding: Greater cone length (>20mm) and volume (>2.5 cm3) after LEEP were associated with a higher risk of preterm birth, and cone length was inversely correlated with gestational age at birth.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not affected by cone characteristics.
